audit.why: The level chart agrees across layers and with the packet: Orianna at 1-2 (Q is 35 mana on 7s from a ball that adds 815 range), Aurora from 3 to first item, Orianna again at 2+ items (Shockwave is the teamfight). No row moved, so no paired win[N] edits were needed.

audit.why: Each stage has an Orianna-specific fact available: at 3 Aurora's E hops her out of the Command: Dissonance slow field (225 radius around the ball); at 6 Command: Shockwave needs the ball inside 410 units, which Aurora's zone slow denies; at first item the punishable timer is Command: Protect's flat 9s.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten against Orianna's own numbers.

audit.why: The two decisive interactions are already on the page and match Riot's text: Command: Shockwave fires from the BALL, not from Orianna, launching everything within 410 units toward it; and Command: Protect is a flat 9s shield that eats a full Q-E-Q, which is the listed _missing shield-absorbs-burst interaction and is already stated in winCon and breakdown.carry. Command: Attack's threat range is the ball's position plus 815.
breakdown.cooldowns carries real numbers: R 110/95/80, E 9s, Q 7s rank 1 into 3s rank 5, Aurora W 22s.
